notes: NDM 1.6.0 — Instant on every site, the IDM way. The extension now watches what your browser actually plays: clicking Download opens the panel with the real quality list instantly (720p, 360p, with bitrates), straight from the stream — HLS, DASH and plain video files on any site, not just YouTube. HLS sound that travels as a separate audio track is downloaded and joined automatically, so the finished file always has sound. The in-app dialog remains as a fallback.
